shop.title: Shop
shop.intro: Restored equipment and parts from Martin Audio Labs. Browse the gallery, then select an item for more photos, details and the price.
shop.howToBuy: To ask about an item or arrange a purchase, use the Inquire button on its page. It opens an email to me with the item already named.

description: This is a sample listing that shows how an item page looks. Replace it with the real description: what the unit is, what was restored, how it sounds, and what is included.
Each paragraph in the description becomes its own paragraph on the page.
